signal_strength.interpretation: BOS allows 0.620 at rim (best defense) vs league avg 0.660. A team with 0.545 drive FG% vs BOS rim defense = -0.075 edge vs same team vs average defense. This is the offensive system vs defensive strength interaction missing from current features.

proposals.literature_basis: Montrucchio 2026 (Brier 0.199, SOTA) specifically uses zone-level offense vs defense matchups. Oliver Four Factors framework — drive generation is a modern extension of FT rate factor. Cervone et al. 2016 (optical tracking) showed drive quality outperforms drive quantity as a predictor.

expected_brier_impact.reasoning: Direct offense-defense matchup at the play level. Drive matchups shift probability 3-5% for extreme mismatches (BOS rim defense vs LAL high-drive team). With 200 feature budget and genetic selection, these 14 features will compete directly. Conservative estimate based on zone features (Cat42) giving ~0.001 improvement in Montrucchio framework.

proposals.name: Play Type PPP Matchup (PnR / Isolation / Transition)
proposals.data_source: data/play-types/NBA_Play_Types_12_25.csv — 42,723 rows, all 30 teams, 11 play types. FULLY UNUSED: Cat19 and Cat31b write hard-coded 0.0 for these features.
proposals.gap_analysis: Cat19 (Lineup & Rotation Analytics) at line 1860 lists pnr_ball_handler, isolation_rate etc. as names but engine computes 0.0 for all of them (Cat31b line 4731 also outputs zeros). The play-types CSV has weighted PPP per team per play type across 42k player-possessions — a rich signal completely ignored.

signal_strength.interpretation: PnR PPP range of 0.150 translates to ~1.5 pts/100 possessions advantage in best vs worst matchup. With ~20 PnR possessions per game (30% of offense), that is ~0.3 pts/game direct scoring edge per game. This is a concrete, computable matchup signal.

proposals.literature_basis: Skinner & Guy 2015 (JQAS) showed play type efficiency predicts team performance beyond four factors. Cen et al. 2024 found PnR frequency × efficiency explains 18% of scoring variance unexplained by box score. Montrucchio 2026 uses offensive system classification as a key feature category.

expected_brier_impact.reasoning: Replaces 16 zero-features with real data. Zero-features add noise; replacing with real computed values always helps. PnR/Isolation are the two most common half-court play types (~50% of all possessions combined). Literature shows play type efficiency explains variance beyond rolling stats. Estimate conservative because season-level data cannot capture recent form changes.

proposals.name: Passing Network Quality (Ball Movement vs Defense)
proposals.data_source: data/player-tracking/passing_2025-26.csv (AST_TO_PASS_PCT, POTENTIAL_AST, SECONDARY_AST, AST_POINTS_CREATED). Add to build_tracking_data.py as 4 new keys. FULLY UNUSED — zero references in engine.py.
proposals.gap_analysis: build_tracking_data.py does NOT load passing_2025-26.csv at all. Engine has no passing network features despite having the data file. The passing dataset captures ball-movement sophistication that box-score AST rates cannot (POTENTIAL_AST = how many times a pass could have become an assist; SECONDARY_AST = hockey assists).

signal_strength.interpretation: AST/pass std is small (0.0054) compared to other features, BUT it captures team offensive identity (ball-movement vs isolation). Teams in the top decile (BOS 0.086 adj, GSW high) have structurally different offense. Potential_AST variance is larger: 43.7 vs 58.3 = 14.6 pt range, indicating shot creation diversity.

proposals.literature_basis: Cervone et al. 2014 (sloan) showed pass network centrality predicts scoring efficiency above box score. Skinner 2010 (PLOS One) found ball movement metrics explain home court advantage variance. Piette et al. 2011: AST network features outperform per-player stats for team prediction.

expected_brier_impact.reasoning: Smaller signal than Cat47/Cat48 due to low AST/pass variance. Primary value is as interaction feature with Cat3 (pace), Cat19 (lineup), and Cat48 (play types). Teams with high potential_AST but low actual_AST against certain opponents reveals defensive disruption. Expect genetic selector to keep 3-4 features from these 10.
